rule: Only APPROVED strategies may reach the execution gateway; passing is a prerequisite, not proof of future profit.

review.text:
What worked
The F&O desk made Rs 1,451.35 net. The NIFTY long straddle returned Rs 2,988 on a time exit, while the NIFTY 25,800 PE lost Rs 1,536.65 after an EMA9 breach. Company P&L was Rs 906.64.

What did not
The scalping desk lost Rs 544.71 over 4 trades with no wins: JPL and KEI shorts hit stops, INDIGO and VEDL timed out. The COO notes its targets hit 2 times against 13.9 expected by chance, so no edge so far. The crypto desk shows a similar pattern. The gateway refused 4 scalping orders on weak reward to risk, and 3 trades were skipped on margin.

What I am changing tomorrow
I will keep doubting signals that lack specific news or price confirmation, such as vague filings and routine resignations. Dev (Quant) is reviewing stop and size rules. Paper results are not proof of an edge.

Watch tomorrow
Sebi's review of the Tata Steel-APL Apollo deal, IT stocks after the 764-point Sensex fall, the Nifty near 25,700, and the 13 open swing positions.
